basic_info.description: All offers encouraged - motivated sellers! Elegant and light-filled top-floor condo in coveted Cole Valley. Nestled on the picturesque, tree-lined Belvedere Street, this classic Marina-style home blends timeless charm with thoughtful, modern updates.  A well-designed and gracious floor plan flows beautifully from the spacious entryway into the expansive West-facing living room with bay windows, a wood-burning fireplace, built-in bookcases, and ornate period details. A large formal dining room with built-in china hutch and French doors provides the perfect entertainment space.  The bright, oversized kitchen offers ample counter space, abundant storage and a sunny breakfast nook ideal for everyday living.  Two serene bedrooms at the back of the home overlook the lush, shared garden and patio, with the primary suite offering double closets and an ensuite half bath. Additional highlights include an office nook, in-unit laundry, updated windows, additional storage spaces, and one-car side-by-side parking with EV charger. Just moments from Cole Valley's beloved shops, cafes, parks, and transit, this exceptional residence captures the very best of San Francisco living.
